import re

DUMP = re.compile(r"^Dumping (?P<name>\S+):$")
NODE = re.compile(r"^(?P<prefix>(?:[ |`][ -])*)(?P<kind>[A-Z]\w+) (?P<address>0x[0-9a-f]+)(?: <(?P<range>.*?)>(?= |$))?(?: (?P<location>(?:line|col|[^\s:<]+):\d+(?::\d+)?))?(?: (?P<detail>\S.*))?$")
NULL = re.compile(r"^(?:[ |`][ -])*<<<NULL>>>$")


def parse(lines):
    nodes, used, skip = [], [], []
    dump, stack = "", []
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = DUMP.match(ln)
        if m:
            dump, stack = m.group("name"), []
            used.append(j)
            continue
        if NULL.match(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        m = NODE.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        depth = len(m.group("prefix")) // 2
        del stack[depth:]
        nodes.append({"dump": dump, "depth": depth, "parent": stack[-1] if stack else "",
                      "kind": m.group("kind"), "address": m.group("address"),
                      "range": m.group("range") or "", "location": m.group("location") or "",
                      "detail": m.group("detail") or ""})
        stack.append(m.group("address"))
        used.append(j)
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "nodes", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": nodes}], "skip": skip}
